title: The Outstanding pupil of the year
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：outstanding　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 outstanding 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the engineer wrote of ① an outstanding pupil of the year in the manual, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② so outstanding that nobody in the workshop would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the engineer, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the outstanding ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the outstanding pupil of the year that anybody there had ever seen, or so the manual for April 1978 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too outstanding to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the outstanding ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lever at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an outstanding debt of the shop, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as outstanding as the debt of the shop they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was outstanding or not, and he said so.

By 1991 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the manual. What the line asked for was ⑦ something outstanding, and nothing besides. The worker from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite outstanding; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the manual kept the names of the outstanding ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1994, for the whole place, she wrote of another outstanding pupil of the year in the same manual, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less outstanding than anybody had expected. ⑩ The outstanding debt of the shop that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1996, was the one she could never quite name; the outstanding ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 杰出（前置定语 an outstanding pupil of the year：1984 年工程师在说明书里记下的那件杰出的学生）
B. adj. 杰出／未结清（两处加强说法：so outstanding that … 与 no less outstanding than …）
C. adj. 杰出／未结清（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 杰出（表语 too outstanding to do：母亲觉得它太杰出，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 未结清（前置定语 an outstanding debt of the shop：叔叔把整件事称作一桩未结清的欠款）
F. adj. 未结清（同级比较 as outstanding as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩店铺未结清的欠款相比）
G. adj. 未结清（后置定语 something outstanding：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 未结清（受程度副词修饰 quite outstanding：那位工人的评价）

items.q: an outstanding pupil of the year
the outstanding pupil of the year that
an outstanding debt of the shop
The outstanding debt of the shop that

answers.why: outstanding 意为“杰出”，1984 年工程师在说明书里记下的是“一件杰出的学生”，此处作前置定语 an outstanding pupil of the year。
outstanding 意为“杰出”，此处用 so outstanding that 结构，说它杰出到车间里没人敢靠近。
outstanding 意为“杰出”，说明书上 四月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的杰出本年度最出色的学生，等于最高级的说法。
outstanding 意为“杰出”，母亲认为这件东西“太杰出了，谁也用不上”，too outstanding to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
outstanding 意为“未结清”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩未结清的欠款”，此处作前置定语 an outstanding debt of the shop。
outstanding 意为“未结清”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩店铺未结清的欠款一样未结清”，同级比较用 as outstanding as。
outstanding 意为“未结清”，说明书上那半行字要的是“未结清的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something outstanding。
outstanding 意为“未结清”，邻车间来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当未结清”，quite 修饰原级 outstanding。
outstanding 意为“未结清”，no less outstanding than 表示“其未结清不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之未结清不亚于任何人的预料。
outstanding 意为“未结清”，母亲 1996 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的未结清欠款”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1984 年，工程师在说明书里记下了一件杰出的学生。（an outstanding pupil of the year）
它杰出到车间里没有一个人敢靠近。（so outstanding that …）
母亲觉得它太杰出，谁也用不上。（too outstanding to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩未结清的欠款。（an outstanding debt of the shop）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩店铺未结清的欠款一样未结清。（as outstanding as …）
到了 1991 年，说明书上只剩半行字：要的是一件未结清的东西。（something outstanding）
answers: In 1984 the engineer wrote of an outstanding pupil of the year in the manual.
It was so outstanding that nobody in the workshop would go near it.
My mother thought it too outstanding to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an outstanding debt of the shop.
He said nobody would call it as outstanding as the debt of the shop they had once had.
By 1991 the manual asked for nothing but something outstanding.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 outstanding 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1984 the engineer wrote of an outstanding pupil of the year in the manual, and nobody forgot it.
It was the outstanding pupil of the year that anybody there had ever seen, or so the manual says.
My mother thought it too outstanding to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an outstanding debt of the shop, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next workshop called the plan quite outstanding, and everybody laughed.
The outstanding ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
